Name: Flowergrass and Snowfields
Author: Alvadea
TagLine: A "More Grass" Content Pack. Adds a beautiful variety of flowers and grass types for every season and little snow piles in winter.
Description:
![](https://i.imgur.com/O05vTNq.jpg)


![](https://imgur.com/br9RloX.png)


This is a content pack for the "More Grass" mod. As such it gives the grass a new look with a wider range of grass and flower types. I tried to create a look with more colorful flowers as in the vanilla game while also keeping its wild touch. It's still a grassland - not a cultivated garden. 


Aaand finally - there is now snow on the grass growing in winter! This improves the feeling of a cold, snowy winter a lot! :D


*Note: I use Eemies Map Recolor as a base here, but it sure looks good with the most other map recolor or the vanilla color scheme.*



![](https://i.imgur.com/4HgJ9np.png)


* Download and install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/)
* Download and install the latest version of [Content Patcher](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/470174-content-patcher)
* Download and install the latest version of [More Grass](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398)
* Download the latest version of this mod and unzip it, then copy the '[MG] Flowergrass and Snowfields' folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
* You're done; run the game using SMAPI!



![](https://i.imgur.com/i7D1UD7.png)
